title: A2A and distributed agent collaboration
subtitle: Treat remote agents as services with identity, tasks, and failure—not shared thoughts.
goal: Delegate work across a real agent service boundary
intro: A remote agent owns a task lifecycle; treat it as a service with permissions and failure modes.
terms: A tracked unit of remote work
case: A support coordinator requests a specialist document review.
The coordinator retains a remote task ID and knows who owns the next action.
A timeout can leave the remote task running after the caller retries.
